title: Deep Remnants
description: Adds new deep dark items for the player to craft and use.
body:
# Deep Remnants
Deep Remnants adds two items for deep dark, a protective relic that absorbs warden sonic booms, and a weapon that lets you fire one back.

## Depth Aegis
Absorbs warden sonic booms. Carries 5 charges, each one consumed on a hit. Can be recharged with echo shards. 
![Depth Aegis Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5dd012d75674eb5750a50601df5a4b091b0f193_0.webp)
![Depth Aegis Refill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48ceb5615682b38c38e9832d1539b65f7c1816ba_0.webp)


## Sonic Cannon
Hold right mouse button to charge, Deals 15 hearts of armor-ignoring damage. (Functions mostly like a crossbow.)
![Sonic Cannon Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da736718ffa1bb76e55f627c01d698cff483407f_0.webp)

Must be on both client and server.
